description.value: Bluebird Market is the sole grocery store within Sun Peaks Resort village, housed inside the Residences at Sun Peaks Grand building with 3,500 square feet of retail space. The market stocks full dairy, fresh produce, an abbreviated meat department, staples, and specialty items including in-season local produce and Oso Negro coffee. For cyclists visiting one of BC's largest four-season mountain bike destinations, it is the primary on-mountain resupply stop.

address.value: 3250 Village Way, Sun Peaks, BC V0E 5N0
